* Product: Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* Price: $129.00

* Availability: In stock, free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* Returns: 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method
* Warranty: 1-year limited warranty
* Specifications: identical — over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours battery, USB-C charging, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite, with carry case, USB-C cable and 3.5mm cable

So you shouldn't pick one based on price, shipping, returns, warranty, or specs, because none of those differ in the listings provided.

If you have prior experience or trust with one of those sellers from outside these pages, use that — otherwise either listing gives you the same stated terms.
